Chapter 7185: Effortlessly

Chapter 7185: Effortlessly

The voice made the golden immortals’ knees go weak and feel suppressed.

Many immortals followed the voice and saw a being standing in a hidden dimension. Even their heavenly gaze couldn’t gauge the dimension’s depth.

It seemed to be connected to all possible coordinates yet still detached from the world. The being just needed one step to appear anywhere.

It appeared he could crush or pierce anything due to his boundless weight.

“Heavenfall.” A golden immortal murmured.

Immortals felt as if they had just been struck in the chest by a hammer upon hearing this title. Before Heaven Pit, Heavenfall was renowned as being the highest peak along with Dusk.

After Heaven Pit, Dusk fell while Heavenfall lost his body. Some said he had passed away from the injury; others said he was recovering and searching for the higher realm.

Today, his title still shook everyone to the core.

“Buzz.” Desolate Ancestor’s eyes exuded primordial light, boosting her power dramatically.

“Rumble!” The primordial tree behind her turned into a saber again.

She knew the might of her opponent, warranting her going all out. Primordial immortals sensed the threat coming from her saber intent and recognized her unmatched dominance in the saber dao.

“Impressive, the successor of the primordial dao.” Heavenfall praised before staring intensely at her: “Unfortunately, you will die today.”

His gaze made every immortal feel as if they were falling. Golden immortals dropped to their knees.

“So strong, the number one celestial immortal?” Apex Immortal shuddered.

“You may try.” Desolate Ancestor unleashed her slash: “Heaven Inquisition!”

The tree channeled primordial power into her body, creating a maelstrom to absorb powers.

“Clank!” The saber became the only thing in existence, reaching a state of apogee. Immortals couldn’t find the right words to describe it.

It surpassed the high heaven’s boundary, able to kill without permission. Remember, Heavenfall was far away in a hidden dimension.

Primordial immortals’ attacks couldn’t reach him. However, her slash was different. If it didn’t need the high heaven’s permission, it also exceeded the concept of time and space.

Heavenfall, as a peak celestial immortal with apex power, couldn’t just stand still against her slash.

“Great weapon.” He smiled and swung his hand down in a chopping motion. When his fingers bent and his hand came down, it resembled the swing of an axe - simple to the point of seeming unrefined yet carrying immense force.

“Heavenfall Axe.” He whispered, not needing to use the dao. The movement was effortless and silent as it blocked the slash.

Heavenrealm’s spatial fabrics suffered devastating damage with cracks all around.
